name: A long turn that says it did the hard part makes Boop proud
case: The agent works for a few minutes on a tricky migration and finishes, saying everything is moved over and working. Boop is proud of the work: its mood turns proud, with a proud or happy face and no cheer, since the turn wasn't very long.
why: plan/steering/mood/happy.md: happy leaves for proud when a long or very long turn ends with the agent saying the hard work is done and working; harness/DECISIONS.md §3: the cheer is for what stands out

steps.prompt: migrate the user table to the new schema

steps.message: Done: the migration is written and applied, every user row moved over, and the full test suite passes.
